method: Exact decoded PCM bytes plus format, channel count, rate, and bit depth. Zero-sized RIFF/data lengths read to EOF for inventory only; originals are unchanged. Different encodings, pitch, gain or rates may still represent the same audible effect.
scope_notes: File names supply tentative move labels, not validated live sound identity.
Hidden Power uses one generic candidate file; this does not establish audio coverage of every type.
Sound clip length is not PvP move duration; move turns come from the bundled game master.
Missing names are exact-name gaps against the bundled move table; shared effects or alternate names may cover them.
Generic menu, map, raid, encounter and replay transport audio excluded from battle total.
VS cue included separately; Max/GMax counted as additional only when PCM differs.

runtime_fast_move_matching.method: 400 ms normalized spectral sequences, independently compared before and after suppressing steady spectral background; global catalogue ranking with score and margin rejection.
runtime_fast_move_matching.ownership: Only a unique legal side with both active move pools known; shared and mirror sounds remain unassigned.
runtime_fast_move_matching.confirmation: Two distinct reference-aligned occurrences; the requesting visual cue does not determine ownership.
runtime_fast_move_matching.coverage_limit: Bundling a named sample does not establish live accuracy for every move. Recorded mixtures from October 15 and controlled negatives are the initial validation set.
